name: Kiro CLI
notes: Reference adapter. Every capability exercised in a multi-week production run.

resume.note: Injects into the same store the IDE uses; the IDE panel may not render an externally started turn even though it runs correctly.

transcript.workspace_hash: opaque per-workspace directory; resolve via list_sessions cwd match

busy.note: status can remain in_progress across an idle gap; the mtime check is the reliable half.

directives.warning: File triggers fire only for changes made by the agent itself. A message dropped by an external process will NOT fire PostFileCreate — use SessionStart plus steering instead.

balance.note: Plan balance is not written to disk. Never estimated; use keyflip for real quota windows.

failure.note: Structural verdict on every tool result. Never text-match for 'error' or 'failed' — the agent's own search patterns and passing test names contain both.

api.auth: Bearer <access_token> from the CLI's own store
api.token_store: ~/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli/data.sqlite3, auth_kv where key='kirocli:odic:token', field access_token
api.response: usageBreakdownList[resourceType=CREDIT].currentUsageWithPrecision and .usageLimitWithPrecision; plus subscriptionInfo, overageConfiguration, nextDateReset, daysUntilReset

billing.api_key_note: A ksk_ API key is NOT a bearer token for this endpoint — it is rejected with AccessDeniedException on codewhisperer and 'Invalid token' on management.kiro.dev. It authenticates the CLI via KIRO_API_KEY. The CLI's cached OIDC access token is what works here.

fallback.note: usage_summary reports the running total of the turn in progress; a turn costs the peak it reached before the next turn resets it. Summing every record over-counts ~3x, taking only the last under-counts ~18x.
fallback.accuracy: a floor — measured at 69% of the account figure, since sessions on other machines are invisible
